page.title: Learning Labs – Interactive labs and atlases
page.description: Explore independent learning labs, scientific models and interactive atlases. Choose a project or follow a journey across them.

early-earth.title: Early Earth
early-earth.description: Explore the young Earth in 3D, zoom through geological time and get a feel for Earth's history with daily exercises.
early-earth.keywords: planet geology oceans atmosphere origins timeline geological timescale training proto-earth accretion

abiogenesis.title: Abiogenesis
abiogenesis.description: Explore prebiotic chemistry, molecular building blocks, protocells and RNA, then compare ideas about the origins of life with the evidence.
abiogenesis.keywords: origin life concentration water evaporation chemistry prebiotic membranes molecules building blocks RNA copying hypotheses research

molecular-biology.title: DNA & RNA
molecular-biology.description: Follow genetic information through DNA, RNA, replication, transcription, translation and mutation.
molecular-biology.keywords: molecular biology genes proteins replication transcription translation mutations

evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.description: Explore population genetics, gene flow, family trees, the last universal common ancestor and major evolutionary transitions. See how scientists weigh the evidence.
evolution.keywords: species natural selection genetic drift populations mutations phylogeny phylogenetics LUCA fossils speciation transitions

human-origins.title: Human Origins
human-origins.description: Trace hominins through time, explore family trees and examine the evidence for walking upright, making tools and moving into new regions.
human-origins.keywords: human ancestry fossils archaeology paleoanthropology palaeoanthropology migration homo sapiens laetoli lucy neanderthals denisovans bipedalism

anthropology-atlas.title: Anthropology Atlas
anthropology-atlas.description: Explore people, places, sources and historical journeys on interactive maps and timelines.
anthropology-atlas.keywords: anthropology history voyages columbus darwin magellan world map timeline places events

people-atlas.title: People Atlas
people-atlas.description: Compare lives in science, philosophy, politics and the arts. Combine categories, read biographies and explore works, contributions and sources in German and English.

maths-atlas.title: Maths Atlas
maths-atlas.description: Follow mathematical proofs step by step. Explore the mind map to see how concepts and theorems connect.
maths-atlas.keywords: math math atlas maths mathematics algebra arithmetic geometry triangle altitude theorem fractions formulas lemma

guide.heading:
One question leads
to the next

about.heading:
Small labs.
Big questions
about.statement: How did the young Earth get its oceans? Why does the altitude theorem hold for every right-angled triangle? I build the Learning Labs around questions I want to answer for myself. For the first, a model helps me picture what happened. For the second, I can work through a proof step by step.
about.invitation: I share what helps me learn so anyone can use it. As you explore, you might come across a question I haven’t even thought of yet.
